name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: EXPERIMENT BUILD, not for production: mid-session periodic cleanup, now also unloading+reloading the osclientcerts PKCS#11 module after each delete (same as Device Manager's Unload/Load buttons), to test whether that avoids the corruption that made 0.2.x/0.3.x unsafe mid-session -- independent of whether NSS 3.128 is present. See tools/thunderbird-cert-cleanup/README.md and the experiment/cert-cleanup-mid-session branch.
